name: The Café
description: Breakfast and lunch made to order, plus pickup and drop-off catering, in Leavenworth, Kansas.
_comment_social: Public handles. Used by the menu tri-fold and the /studio/ social pieces; the QR art in assets/qr-facebook.svg and assets/qr-website.svg encodes these same two URLs.
_comment_owners: The two names on the door. On the opening post because a small-town reopening is shared for the people, not the premises — friends and family scrolling past recognise a name long before they read an address. There is no team page: the staff do not want photos online, so src/team.njk is not published.
_comment_ordering: The online ordering page (Square, reached through Cash App: cash.app/$lvcafetogo, set 2026-10-02). Every Order Online button and every 'online ordering is coming soon' line on the site and in the post captions keys off `url`: empty means no button and a coming-soon note, filled means the button. It is an off-site link by design (a custom domain needs a paid Square plan).
_comment_opening: Opening day. Read by the front door banner and the Facebook pieces in /studio/ so the date is stated once. Not billed as a grand opening — the kitchen is still transitioning off the old contract, so the doors open first and a grand opening comes later.
_comment_construction: Set to false to remove the under-construction banner from every page at once.
_comment_survey: Where /survey sends its answers (Formspree, by email). It shares the newsletter form on /contact until a form of its own is made in Formspree: swap the URL here and every survey link follows. Survey emails carry the subject 'Customer survey'. Mind Formspree's monthly submission limit on the free plan, which is shared across every form on the account.
_comment_phoneOrders: false while the kitchen can't take food orders by phone (client, 2026-10-02: not for the first few weeks after opening, for capacity). Every 'call ahead' line on the site and in the generated post captions is conditional on this, so flipping it to true turns them all back on. Catering inquiries by phone are separate and always shown.
constructionNotice: Pardon our crumbs. This site is still under construction, so some details may change.
